abilities.name: Off in a Huff
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of each target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Court of Creepers
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Hero or Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit charged this turn. On a 3+: • Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn. • The target cannot use Rampage abilities for the rest of the turn. • The target no longer has any artefacts of power.

abilities.name: Set 'Em Up, Then Knock 'Em Down!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If there are 3 or more friendly Big or Little models in combat with the target, apply the effect below. Otherwise, make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+, apply the effect below. abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of The Dread Mace is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

abilities.name: Avatar of Destruction
abilities.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: The End of Empires
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly Destruction units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: The Shield Inviolate
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a Spell ability
abilities.effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per Spell ability.

abilities.name: Rampaging Destruction
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects: • Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. • Pick an enemy Monster in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Shipwrecka Warclub is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilities.name: Shipwrecka Warclub

abilities.name: Get Orf Me Land!
abilities.declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature on the battlefield to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, the target is this unit's loot hoard. While the unit that used this ability is contesting its loot hoard, add 10 to its control score. While the unit that used this ability is not contesting its loot hoard, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its Almighty Stomp.

abilities.name: Greedy Show-Offs
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly Big or Little unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If this unit is contesting its loot hoard, apply the effect below. Otherwise, make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+, apply the effect below. Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Shipwrecka Warclub is 3 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

abilities.name: Lurking Beneath the Waves
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit in reserve beneath the waves. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: Emerge from the Deep
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is beneath the waves.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge.

abilities.effect: If the target is within this unit's combat range, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+, pick 1 of the effects below. *Gore their Guts!*: If the target is in combat, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target's Mighty Horns and Hooves for the rest of the turn. *Ghyroch Rush*: If the target is not in combat, it can move 3". It can move into combat. *Reservoirs of Jade Energy*: Add 1 to this unit's casting power level until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Creepy Cantrips
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Sons of Behemat Monster unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to rampage rolls for the target and add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks.

abilities.name: The Wandering Witch
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of another friendly Sons of Behemat Monster unit, this unit is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away from it.

abilities.name: Chooser of the Mighty
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly Little unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be mighty.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects: • For the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified wound roll of 6 for a combat attack made by the mighty unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target of the attack after the Fight ability has been resolved. • Pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of the mighty unit, then pick a friendly non-Unique Big unit that has been destroyed to be the target. Set up a replacement unit identical to the target within 1" of that point, then allocate 10 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). The replacement unit can only be set up in combat with units that the mighty unit was in combat with when it was picked to be mighty. Then, 1 model in the mighty unit is slain.

abilities.name: Bet You Can't...
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly Mancrusher Gargant on the battlefield to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects: *...Kill the Big 'Eads!*: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target's melee weapons while they are in combat with any enemy Heroes or Monsters. *...Get There Before Me!*: Up to 3 of the targets can each use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase. *...Grab That!*: Add 5 to each target's control score for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Excitable Followers
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a visible friendly Sons of Behemat Hero, this unit can use 2 Fight abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Statue Tossing
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the Damage characteristic of this unit's Throwin' Rocks is 3 instead of D3. Then, you can spend up to 3 rage dice. If you do: • For each rage dice spent, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Throwin' Rocks for the rest of the turn. • If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.

abilities.name: Drop, Toss or Roll
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn: *Drop*: This unit's ranged weapons have Shoot in Combat and this unit can use the 'Covering Fire' command even if it is in combat. *Toss*: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's ranged weapons. *Roll*: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged

abilities.name: Don't Stomp Those; Stomp Them!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly Big or Little unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that has not been set up this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can move 2D6". It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that it was in combat with at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: Almightier Stompin'
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase

abilities.effect: Make a rampage roll of D3. If any models are slain by those attacks, for the rest of the turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Titanic Boulderclub
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a Fight ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Titanic Boulderclub.

battleTraits.name: Take a Run at It
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly Big or Little units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise. • Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets. • The target is building momentum for the rest of the turn. • If the target is within 3" of a battlefield edge, remove it from the battlefield and set it up in reserve beyond the horizon. • For the rest of the phase, the target can pass through enemy models and terrain features when using Move abilities as if it had Fly.

battleTraits.name: Argy Bargy
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly Big or Little units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise. • Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets. • If the target is building momentum, it is no longer building momentum and is getting ready for the rest of the turn instead. • For the rest of the turn, each time the target makes a pile-in move, add 3" to the distance it can move.

battleTraits.name: Wrathful Rampaging
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly Sons of Behemat units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise. • Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets. • If the target is Little and is getting ready, it is no longer getting ready and has Strike-First for the rest of the turn instead. • If the target is Big and is getting ready, it is no longer getting ready. Instead, either it has Strike-First for the rest of the turn or it is prepping the big one for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Haring Back
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: If a friendly unit is in reserve beyond the horizon, you must pick that unit to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that unit within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If it is not possible to set it up, it wanders off and is automatically destroyed.

battleTraits.name: The Big One
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly Big or Little units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise. • Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets. • If the target is prepping the big one, pick an enemy unit in combat with it and roll any number of dice. If any of the rolls are a 1, the target is no longer prepping the big one. Otherwise, add the results together, then inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the total.

abilities.name: Arrogant Big 'Uns
abilities.effect: In the first battle round, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly Big and Little units that have not charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Ten-League Strides
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly Big or Little unit uses the 'Redeploy' command or the 'Run' ability, if you roll a 1-2 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 3 instead.

abilities.name: Brute Spirituality
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Big or Little unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy Wizard or Priest within 18" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic: • The target has a maximum power level of 1 until the start of your next turn. • All Manifestations that were summoned by the target are banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: Get to the Goods
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly Big or Little unit that charged in the same turn makes a pile-in move, that unit can pass across enemy models in non-Monster units.

abilities.name: Always First In
abilities.effect: This unit can move 2D6". It must end that move more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Brute of Brutes
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks.

abilities.name: One-hit Wonder
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: This unit can make a pile-in move. Then, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each battle round in which this unit was on the battlefield in both combat phases and did not use any Fight abilities. On a 6+, inflict 4D6 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Spell-chomper
abilities.effect: This unit can use Unbind and Banish abilities as if it had Wizard (1). In addition, each time an enemy Manifestation within this unit's combat range is banished, Heal (D3) this unit.

abilities.name: Thundering Titan

abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a non-Hero enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic, this unit cannot be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target while there are other friendly Sons of Behemat units in combat with the target.

abilities.name: Unreasonable Tyrant
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly Sons of Behemat Monster unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Enchanted Portcullis
abilities.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).

abilities.name: Glowy Lantern
abilities.effect: If this unit is a Wizard or Priest, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the battle. Otherwise, pick either the Wizard (1) or Priest (1) keyword. This unit has that keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Krakenskin Sandals
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic, Rend characteristic and Damage characteristic of this unit's Almighty Stomp.

abilities.name: Mantle of the Wood-Kings
abilities.effect: If this unit charged in the same turn, while it is in combat with 2 or more enemy units, add 1 to hit rolls for its combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Massive Stuffin' Sack
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 3 dice. For each roll that is at least double the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain.

abilities.name: Protecty Bits
abilities.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

abilities.name: Energy Surge
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Sons of Behemat Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Sons of Behemat Monster unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If the target is Big, add 1 to rampage rolls for it until the start of your next turn. If the target is Little, until the start of your next turn, it can use Charge abilities even if it used a Run ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Pipsqueak Curse
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Sons of Behemat Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Thornfang's Wrath
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Sons of Behemat Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Sons of Behemat Monster unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target's melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Rock Bottom
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Sons of Behemat Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Sons of Behemat unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn: • Ignore the effects of the 'Battle Damaged' ability on each target. • Each target has Ward (6+).

abilities.name: The Terrible Toes
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Sons of Behemat Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the roll. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any enemy models are slain by this ability, halve the target's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Vocal Tectonics
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Sons of Behemat Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each target has Strike-last.

abilities.name: World Titan's Stride

abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the target's Move characteristic and models in the target unit can pass across enemy models and terrain features as if it had Fly. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, for the rest of the turn, each time the target uses the 'Normal Move' or 'Run' ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit the target passed across as part of that move.

abilities.name: Might of the Earth
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Sons of Behemat Priest to chant this prayer, pick each friendly Sons of Behemat unit on the battlefield to be the targets, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Heal (D3) each target. If the chanting roll was 8+, Heal (3) each target instead.

abilities.name: Behemat's Vengeance
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Sons of Behemat Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Sons of Behemat Monster unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Shards of Valagharr

abilities.name: Summon Malevolent Maelstrom
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Soulsnare Shackles

abilities.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: Summon Suffocating Gravetide
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Burning Head
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly The Burning Head endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a The Burning Head endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Emerald Lifeswarm
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Geminids of Uhl-Gysh
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizardto cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Summon Prismatic Palisade
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Prismatic Palisade endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Prismatic Palisade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Summon Umbral Spellportal
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Umbral Spellportal endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Umbral Spellportal wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. An Umbral Spellportal has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Battered Shrimp
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy non-Monster Hero in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Both players roll off. If you win the roll-off, roll off again. Keep rolling off in this way until you lose the roll-off. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the number of roll-offs made as part of this ability that you won this turn.

abilities.name: Colossal Slam
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Monster or War Machine that has no more than 1 model and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If 2 or more friendly Big or Little units are in combat with the target, apply the effect below. Otherwise, make a rampage roll of D6. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target has a higher Health characteristic than this unit. On a 3+, apply the effect below. Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again in combat with this unit. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Earthshaking Roar
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Hammer Throw
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly Mancrusher Gargant within its combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 3D6. On a 4+, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within a number of inches of this unit equal to the roll and visible to this unit. It can be set up in combat. The target cannot use Charge abilities for the rest of the turn. If the target is set up in combat: • Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. • Inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target. • The target has charged this turn.

abilities.name: Rancid Flatulence
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Windmill Walloping
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Monster or War Machine in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic. Add 1 to each roll for each consecutive turn in which the target was picked to be the target of this ability. For each 6+, allocate 1 mortal damage to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: Always On Guard
abilities.effect: This unit has Ward (5+) while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Big unit.

abilities.name: That Boy's Not Right
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, this unit can use a Prayer ability from the prayer lore you picked during army composition as if it had Priest (1). Instead of making a chanting roll for that prayer, the chanting roll is 5 and cannot be modified.

abilities.name: Up For It
abilities.effect: This unit's melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage).
